name: Quench / fixing tank

operatingEnvelope.h2o2DoseRatio: 1.875 kg (1.625 L) of 50 wt% H₂O₂ per kg PRE-G treated, subject to pilot data
operatingEnvelope.batchBasis: One fixing batch per R-201 batch (550 kg Pre-G ≈ 688 kg TLGO); 2.4 batches/day nominal, 3.2 design
operatingEnvelope.h2o2DosingTemperatureMaxC: ≤ 40 (H₂O₂ decomposition on Mn²⁺ accelerates with temperature; dosing at 45–50 °C wastes reagent and peaks O₂)

reviewFindings: Draft process basis only; no approved ratings, capacity, control loops or protective setpoints are asserted.
Model route alignment and destination qualification remain open under A300-001.

safeguards.ventBasis: H₂O₂ quench generates O₂ — vent to scrubber, no closed system; vent sized for O₂ evolution and acid mist
safeguards.dosingInterlock: HCl and H₂O₂ dosing interlocked with agitator operation; H₂O₂ dosing reduced or stopped on high temperature
safeguards.oxygenEvolution: 310–340 Nm³ O₂ per batch, ≈ 160 Nm³/h peak over a 2 h dose; segregate from the common A-3000 header carrying H₂ (F-46 Critical) — wet scrubber only
